displayName: DiamondEcho SRE: API slow (p95 above 2.5 seconds)

documentation.subject: DiamondEcho: the API is answering slowly
documentation.content:
For 10 minutes, 1 in 20 of the API's answers (the 95th percentile, p95) took longer than 2.5 seconds, measured by Cloud Run itself, with at least 30 requests in the 15-minute window. The minimum count is there because the API scales to zero: on a quiet night a single cold start would otherwise be the whole p95.

The GitHub monitor's latency target (1 second, measured from outside) is in scripts/sre/slo.config.mjs; this alert is the server-side view and is deliberately looser so it only fires on real, sustained slowness.

What to do: follow docs/sre/runbooks/api-slow-or-saturated.md. Logs Explorer filter for the slow routes: jsonPayload.event="request.slow" on service diamondecho-api.

The 2.5 seconds, 10 minutes and 30 requests are proposed starting values, not tuned against measured traffic (none has been measured yet).

This message carries no visitor data.
